title: Settings 0.1.12
brief: Four pieces for the 0.1.12 delivery: a read-only Profiles section, an Account section with terminal hand-off, an Updates section (auto check at open, buttons gated on zero open chats), and a context-percentage chip beside the chat composer. Settings join the existing 680px two-rail dialog.

artboards.title: A: the familiar rail grows
artboards.tradeoff: One dialog everyone knows; the rail gains three entries and Updates shows status rows with the chats-closed gate

artboards.title: B: Profiles and Account as quiet ledgers
artboards.tradeoff: Dense, scannable tables for read-only data; weaker emotional pull than cards

artboards.title: C: the context chip lives in the chat
artboards.tradeoff: Per-chat number beside the composer with its five states; detail one hover away, never default

artboards.title: D: Account, its own quiet section
artboards.tradeoff: Auth status and terminal hand-off get their own rail entry; nothing shares the Profiles pane's length
